subject: TTL exception runbooks and attestation for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: AuditCorp SOC2 <auditor@auditcorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence request — TTL exceptions + runbooks

Hi Rishi / Laura,

As part of the NorthBank SOC 2 readiness bundle we need artifacts showing how TTL (time-to-live) exceptions are handled across tenant data lifecycles. Specifically: 
- A copy of the "TTL exception" operational runbook(s) that operators follow when an exception is requested (who approves, steps to mark tenant excluded from automated erasure, and the rollback process).
- Sample deletion job logs that show a normal TTL deletion and an exception-triggered skip (CSV or JSON).
- Any attestation or sign-off template you use when approving manual retention/exception windows.

Can you provide these artifacts by COB Mon Oct 26? If you have a preferred format or a small excerpt first that shows the approval chain (timestamps, actor ids), please send that — we can accept redacted examples. Also confirm whether exceptions are global (all regions) or per-geozone.

Thanks,
Alex (AuditCorp)

—
AuditCorp SOC 2 Team
auditor@auditcorp.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, AuditCorp SOC2 <auditor@auditcorp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request — TTL exceptions + runbooks (runbook and samples attached)

Forwarding the artifacts — attaching redacted samples and runbook excerpts per Alex's ask. Summary of what's attached: 

1) ttl-exception-runbook.pdf — operator steps, approval matrix, rollback checklist, and SRE contact path. The runbook includes a small decision tree for region-specific overrides (US/EU/APAC).
2) deletion-log-sample.csv — three rows: normal automated deletion, manual exception recorded, manual erasure after exception expiry. IDs are hashed; timestamps and job IDs preserved.
3) runbook-ack-template.docx — the short sign-off template we use when product/security approve an exception.

Excerpt (from runbook) — operator procedure: 
- Request received via NORMS ticket -> Product owner approves in ticket within 24h -> Security tags request as "TTL Exception" and sets expiration date -> SRE updates exception list (kv-store key: tenant:{id}:ttl_exemption) -> nightly deletion job checks exemption kv and skips if present -> upon expiry SRE removes key and deletion resumes.

Note: Exceptions are scoped by tenant and by geozone. Global exceptions are rare and require VP approval (see page 3 of runbook).

If you need unredacted identifiers for sampling purposes we can provide a separate dataset under NDA; for SOC 2 the hashed-sample is usually sufficient.

Attachments: ttl-exception-runbook.pdf (PDF), deletion-log-sample.csv (CSV), runbook-ack-template.docx (DOCX)

—
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success (on-call)
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: AuditCorp SOC2 <auditor@auditcorp.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Castro <marta.castro@northbank.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:28:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — TTL exceptions + runbooks

Thanks Laura — this is helpful. A few follow-ups: 
1) The runbook excerpt looks good; can you confirm the exact kv-store key names and the ACLs on who can write/remove keys? We need evidence that only authorized operators and the SRE runbook role can toggle exemptions.
2) For the deletion-log-sample.csv — the job_id and timestamp columns are perfect. For our SOC pack we also want a short chain-of-custody note for manual removals (e.g., who requested, who approved, checklist ticked). The runbook-ack-template covers the approval but if you have a filled example (redacted) that shows the approval chain end-to-end that would be ideal.
3) We do require a signed attestation that exceptions are only granted under documented approvals and that exceptions are time-bounded. DocuSign is preferred — can you send a signed DocuSign envelope or confirm you'll return a signed PDF by Oct 27 so we can include in the control mapping?

If you can answer 1–3 and upload by EOD Oct 26 we'll be able to include Redwood in the SOC 2 draft package.

Best,
Alex

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: AuditCorp SOC2 <auditor@auditcorp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — TTL exceptions + runbooks (attestation + ACLs)

Hi Alex — thanks for the note. Quick answers inline: 
1) KV keys: tenant:{tenant_hash}:ttl_exemption and tenant:{tenant_hash}:ttl_exemption_meta. Only members of the SRE_Runbooks role and the PlatformOps service account (svc-platformops@redwood.com) have write/delete ACLs. We enforce RBAC in our IAM system; policy ids are RBAC-PR-37 (SRE_Runbooks) and SVC-PLAT-01. I can pull IAM audit entries showing which principal modified a key during the sample timeframe.

2) Attached is a redacted completed ack using runbook-ack-template.docx that shows request -> product approval -> security review -> SRE action and a timestamped ticket link. See attached: signed-attestation.pdf (this also contains the short attestation paragraph you requested).

3) DocuSign: we'll send the attestation via DocuSign now; link below once envelope is created. If you prefer immediate delivery we can also email a signed PDF (included).

We are also preparing a CSV export of deletion job_ids you requested — will send that by EOD.

Let me know if you need the IAM audit logs in any specific format (CSV or zipped JSON).

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head, Security & Compliance
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: signed-attestation.pdf

From: AuditCorp SOC2 <auditor@auditcorp.com>

Subject: Re: Evidence request — TTL exceptions + runbooks (final checks)

Stephanie — received, thank you. The attestation and runbook excerpt are sufficient for the mapping. Two last items before we close the evidence item: 
- Please upload the IAM audit CSV showing a write/delete event for tenant:{tenant_hash}:ttl_exemption during the sample week (timestamps and actor ids hashed are fine).
- A CSV with three sample deletion job_ids and their outcome (deleted/skip/manual_erasure) — hashed tenant ids OK.

If you can drop both into the Drive folder (link below) by EOD we’ll mark this resolved in the SOC tracker.

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ttl-runbooks

Appreciate the speedy turnaround.

—
Alex, AuditCorp
